The  best  salespeople  say  the  script, 
 they  follow  up  quickly,  they  ask  good 
 questions,  they  listen,  and  they  allow 
 the  prospect  to  close  themselves.  The 
 thing  that  separates  the  good  sales 
 people  from  the  great  salespeople  is 
 that  the  great  salespeople  never  don't 
 do  the  basics.  They  always  do  the 
 fundamentals.  And  when  you  always  do  the 
 fundamentals,  you  will  sustain 
 exceptionally  high  close  rates.
